title: Decoding the Panji of Mithila
subtitle: Surprising Insights from India and Nepal’s Oldest Social Network
creator: Gajendra Thakur · Videha
description: A theoretical and documentary introduction to Panji as genealogy, kinship system, social memory, administrative practice, and a long-duration archive linking Mithila in India and Nepal.

title: Decoding the Panji of Mithila — Volume II
subtitle: Genome Mapping Volume I: Khaṇḍa 1 · Index-Linked Edition
creator: Gajendra Thakur · Videha

title: Decoding the Panji of Mithila — Volume III
subtitle: A Complete Index-wise Decoding of Genome Mapping Volume I: Khaṇḍa 2 · Based on Uptip Panji
creator: Gajendra Thakur · Videha
description: An index-controlled reading of the Uptip Panji, its formulae, historical span, village corridors, titles, and genealogical entries from the early framing chapters through detailed decoding.
structure: How to read entries and symbols

title: Decoding the Panji of Mithila — Volume IV
subtitle: Based on the Nagram Panji
creator: Gajendra Thakur · Videha
description: A large-scale decoding of the Nagram Panji, beginning with editorial method and genealogical grammar and proceeding through village-rooted entries with a cumulative index logic.

title: Decoding the Panji of Mithila — Volume V
subtitle: Based on Volume II Panji: Genealogical Mapping of Mithila, 450–2009 CE
creator: Gajendra Thakur · Videha
description: A branch-by-branch decoding of compressed Panji records, with attention to names, marriages, titles, locations, scholarly identities, and modern continuations across the regional network.

title: Decoding the Panji of Mithila — Volume VI
subtitle: Based on Dushan Panji · Chapters 1–30 · Appendices A–K
creator: Gajendra Thakur · Videha
description: An ethically framed study of Dushan Panji as a difficult archive of social memory, read within the wider Panji system and decoded without reproducing inherited stigma as judgment.

title: Gajendra Thakur’s Parallel Philosophy
